instruction.text: Schiebe die Passivbildungen und Beispielsätze zur richtigen Zeitform.

atoms.sound: have, has been. plus past participle

atoms.b: She had been visited before he called.

atoms.a: Der Berlin Marathon wurde von 50.000 Menschen bestritten.
Keine meiner DVDs wurde in den letzten Jahren benutzt.
Die Musik wurde gestoppt, bevor ich anfangen konnte zu tanzen.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im present perfect? Wähle ihn aus.
instruction.sound: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und im <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m2'>present perfect</voice> Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++The letter has been written two years ago.
The letter was written two years ago.
She has been writing the letter two years ago.
++My bad knees haven't been examined in years.
My bad knees hadn't been examined in years.
My bad knees weren't examined in years.

instruction.text: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und past perfect? Wähle ihn aus.
instruction.sound: Welcher Satz steht im Passiv und <voice voiceLang='en' voice='f3'>past perfect</voice> Wähle ihn aus.

b: ++After the food had been cooked, Demi and Joseph prepared the table.
After the food is cooked, Demi and Joseph will prepare the table.
After the food was cooked, Demi and Joseph prepared the table.
++Before the dog could even react, he had been bitten by the cat.
Before the dog could even react, he has been bitten by the cat.
Before the dog could even react, he was bitten by the cat.

instruction.text: Schreibe die Passivform in der gegebenen Zeitform in die Lücke.

atoms.b: It was still good so the bread ((has_been_eaten)), although it has already expired.
He wanted to go pay at the counter but the bill ((has_been_paid)) by Carla already.
Anka and Sinem ((have_been_noticed)) when they were hiding from their fellow students.
The thieves ((have_been_caught)) and are now under arrest.
The vegetables ((had_been_put)) into the freezer in reusable containers before they went bad.
Before Manolo called, he ((had_been_left)) a message by me.
After the bedroom ((had_been_rearranged)), Leo slept much better.
